_source: The Flight design document pp. 20-22 (Research: the nine trees; costs; the order of work); p11 (the Roost)

roost.what: The colony's first structure after the nest: research happens here, one line at a time

shrine.what: Faith 1: priests tend it, the Founder prays at it, offerings are laid on it

works.what: Bombing 1 / Chemistry 1: bombs from guano and sulfur, stimulants from guano and pearls

nesting.name: Cliff nests
nesting.what: nest sites on vertical rock anywhere (+50% sites)

nesting.name: Hanging colony
nesting.what: nests under overhangs, immune to rock-throws and ash

fishing.name: Schooling eye
fishing.what: fishers see schools from farther (they find fish 40% sooner)

fishing.name: Deep dive
fishing.what: fishers work the oyster beds: pearls

fishing.name: Night fishing
fishing.what: fishers work dusk and dawn safely

fishing.name: Cooperative fishing
fishing.what: fishers herd a school together: double yield, triple splash

flight.name: Thermal riding
flight.what: free altitude on tropical and volcanic islands

flight.name: Wind reading
flight.what: wind penalties halved; the chart shows the wind a day ahead

flight.name: Formation flight
flight.what: flocks fly 30% faster in a V

caches.name: Nets
caches.what: Watchers' nets hold 5 s; fishers net small schools

war.name: Towers and hedges
war.what: Watchers' towers (sight +50%, nets) and hedges round the nests

war.name: Flockmasters and sieges
war.what: the Flockmaster role and the siege order (a flock blockades a ground)

bombing.name: The Works
bombing.what: makes bombs from guano and sulfur: 1 a day

bombing.name: Incendiary
bombing.what: burns hedges and nests; skull island's plants

bombing.name: Blockbuster
bombing.what: one bomb per two days; destroys a Roost or a tower outright

chemistry.name: The Works
chemistry.what: shared with Bombing; the Chemist role

chemistry.name: Haste
chemistry.what: a flock +30% speed for a day; afterward a day of half stamina

chemistry.name: Fury and Clot
chemistry.what: Fury: attack +40%, it won't retreat, bleeds more; Clot: bleeding halved

chemistry.name: The Draught
chemistry.what: one flock, one day: all stats +50%, immune to morale; then it sleeps a full day

faith.name: The shrine
faith.what: the shrine and the Priest role (fervour)

faith.name: Offerings
faith.what: fish for fervour; +10 per big fish

faith.name: Conversion
faith.what: priests turn wild birds into colony birds

faith.name: Zeal
faith.what: at fervour 100 the colony works through nights and warriors never rout; priests convert enemy birds near the shrine

trade.name: Traders
trade.what: the Trader role and the market screen

trade.name: Egg theft
trade.what: any Skirmisher can carry an enemy egg home

trade.name: Brood parasitism
trade.what: lay an egg in an enemy nest; the Pathfinder role
